title: Retro
summary: What a team learned from a stretch of work, and the experiments it will try next.

facets.label: What we saw
facets.hint: The moment or pattern that prompted this, in one or two sentences.

facets.label: Try
facets.hint: The experiment, small enough to run before the next retro.

facets.label: We will know when
facets.hint: The signal that says it worked.

facets.label: Note
facets.hint: Anything the team must know that fits nowhere else.

sections.title: Context
sections.hint: The stretch of work in one paragraph: dates, goal, and how it went.

sections.title: Worth keeping
sections.hint: One line for each habit or tool that earned its place.

sections.title: Experiments
sections.hint: Each experiment the team could try before the next retro.

legend: Effort is agent time, not calendar time: S is under an hour, M is a few hours with review, L is a day or more across sessions.

decision.title: Choose the experiments
decision.markdown: Choose experiments by number. Numbers without a word mean try.
decision.example: try 1, 3; later 2. Notes: 3: pair on it first.
